snippet.title: Home Sweet Bunker: Bunker Tycoon - Trailer
snippet.description:
I made Home Sweet Bunker: Bunker Tycoon on my own: check every survivor at the gate with a thermometer, a UV lamp and their papers, then dig down from a backyard shelter to a mega-bunker and hold the nights.

Out now on Steam for Windows and Mac, in 16 languages:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5493880/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=trailer

Streaming and videos are welcome, monetized too. No need to ask.
